"'Oh,' cried the one-armed captain, "'Oh, yes. Well, after he sounded we didn't
see him again for some time. In fact, as I before hinted, I didn't then know what
whale it was that had served me such a trick, till some time afterwards. When coming back
to the line, we heard about Moby Dick, as some call him. And then I knew it was he.'"
